text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Gah! And I was so close, too! I knew she
wouldn't
go easy on me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
You can say that again. Still,
complaining won't
get me anywhere.
choice_data_list: The G1 barrier really is tough.
The G1 barrier really is tough, isn't it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
The next Tiara will be mine. I'm not
going to give
up, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: But the me right now won't cut it. Not to mention, she's also getting stronger.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Just so we're clear, I'm not scared of her
or
anything. I'm only speaking the truth.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm a long way from being number one. I
have to
get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Sitting here sulking isn't going to do me
any
good. The Japanese Oaks is just
around the
corner.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I won't let anyone take the title of
Queen of the
Oaks away from me! That
number one spot is
mine!
